flags.amal_said: دير بالك is actually the command form.
flags.why: The 'your' ending on بال is -ak (بالك), not -eek; Amal gave دير بالك and told him it is the command form.
Listing what is in the sky he gave a singular; Amal asked 'just one?' and he gave the plural غيوم.
One goes after the noun (or alone); he put واحدة first and Amal only kept واحدة without comment.
Wrong shape of the she-past (long -aat ending, no doubled l); Amal recast تَلَّجَت with vowels and he repeated ثلّجت.

flags.amal_said: إيش يعني؟ ... Tell me it was very strong. The wind was very strong in the mornings.
flags.why: 'The wind came a lot' did not say what he meant; Amal asked 'إيش يعني؟' and steered him in English to 'it was very strong', which he then said (كان قوي كتير).

flags.medi_said: El nar, nar heret me. Does that count correct?
flags.why: Repeating her 44:14 sentence he used English 'me' instead of the -ni ending; she recast النار حرقتني (wrong form after her model = own slip).
For dirt under the ground he tried رمل; Amal said that is sand, then he found تراب and she confirmed 'تراب is dirt or soil'.

flags.amal_said: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون. ... في is not is. في is there is.
flags.why: For 'isn't here' he used في (there is) instead of هون; Amal said 'مش في. مش هون' and explained في is 'there is'.
